description:
Record an interaction outcome for an agent. kind: success | delivered |
    dispute_won | failure | undelivered | dispute_lost | timeout |
    security_incident (security incidents carry a 3x penalty).

counterparty.description: Optional. Id of the other party.
counterparty.title: Counterparty

kind.description: success, delivered, dispute_won, failure, undelivered, dispute_lost, timeout or security_incident.
kind.title: Kind

weight.description: Optional. Weight of this outcome. Default 1.
weight.title: Weight

name: record_outcome
title: Record outcome
